# Investment Memorandum

## 1. Executive Summary

- On February 26, 2021, Array Tech, Inc. (formerly Array Technologies, Inc.) executed an incremental facility amendment to increase its revolving credit commitment by $50 million.
- Array Tech, Inc., a New Mexico corporation in the solar tracking technology sector, serves as the Borrower, with ATI Investment Sub, Inc. (Delaware corporation) as Holdings and Array Technologies Patent Holding Co., LLC as Guarantor.
